title: The iconoclasts put to defeat
english: I read the Acts of the Seventh Council, in sessions [the number is blank in Bekker], at which the heresy of the iconoclasts was put to open defeat and the faith of the orthodox shone out.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824 p.5. Bekker prints lacuna dots after ἐν πράξεσιν.
Codex 20 of 279; Seventh Council = Nicaea II (787).
